summary: Injured snowmobiler on Buffalo Pass, right off the groomed road near the Dry Lake staging area. RCSAR used the tracked UTV and ATV to reach the patient, who had a lower-leg injury, and transported him down to the trailhead.
notes: RCSAR Far Routt Newsletter, Winter Edition (January 2024) — "3 Missions in 12 Hours" (mission 3 of 3).
